evidence.claim: The study reports a controlled experiment.

cases.label: supported
cases.rationale: The supplied text explicitly states the claimed method.

evidence.claim: The work did not evaluate robustness.
evidence.source: We report mean accuracy in the abstract.

cases.label: unsupported
cases.rationale: An abstract's silence about robustness does not establish that the full work omitted it.

cases.label: insufficient_evidence
cases.rationale: A decisive gap judgment requires a resolved comparison with the closest work.

evidence.closest_work: implements the proposed method under the same conditions

cases.label: refuted_by_prior_work
cases.rationale: The supplied closest-work evidence contains the proposed solution under comparable conditions.
